items.title: Explainable AI-Driven Cyber Risk Analytics and Model Reliability Assessment for Intelligent Governance of U.S. Critical Infrastructure: An XGBoost and SHAP-Based Intrusion Detection Framework
items.summary: The increasing penetrations of the critical infrastructure sector in the United States with intelligent digital technologies have greatly increased exposure to advanced cyber adversaries and operational vulnerabilities. AI-powered governance and automated decision-making systems are becoming a key part of the operation of critical infrastructure systems, including energy, healthcare, transportation, financial services, and communication infrastructure, in order to improve efficiency and strategic management. The growing cyber threat environment, such as Distributed Denial of Service (DDos) attacks, botnets, ransomware, and Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs) pose significant challenges to infrastructure resilience, cyber security reliability, and governance trustworthiness. In a changing attack landscape and dynamic network environment, traditional cybersecurity mechanisms can often fall short of meeting the evolving needs and protecting critical systems. This study will develop a resilient cyber risk analytics and model reliability assessment framework to support intelligent governance and decision support for cyber risk exposure in the U.S. critical infrastructure environment. This study is based on the CICIDS2017 dataset for the development and testing of intrusion detection system models and cyber risk prediction models based on machine learning. Various classifiers like XGBoost, Random Forest, and Decision Tree are used to detect malicious activities on the network and determine the level of cyber risk. Furthermore, the Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) techniques are integrated to enhance transparency, interpretability, and trust in cybersecurity decision-making processes. The proposed framework presents the reliability and resilience of the model by having various performance measures such as accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, ROC-AUC, and false positive rate.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本研究针对美国关键基础设施（能源、医疗、交通、金融、通信等）在数字化转型过程中面临的日益严峻的网络威胁，如分布式拒绝服务攻击、僵尸网络、勒索软件和高级持续性威胁。传统网络安全机制在动态攻击环境下往往难以满足保护关键系统的需求。为此，作者提出一个基于可解释人工智能的网络风险分析与模型可靠性评估框架，以支持智能治理和决策。研究采用公开的CICIDS2017数据集，利用XGBoost、随机森林、决策树等机器学习分类器构建入侵检测和网络风险预测模型。特别地，框架集成了可解释人工智能（XAI）技术（如SHAP），以增强模型决策过程的透明度和可解释性，提升对网络安全决策的信任。实验通过准确率、精确率、召回率、F1分数、ROC-AUC和假阳性率等指标评估模型的可靠性和弹性。论文主要贡献在于将XAI与机器学习驱动的入侵检测相结合，为关键基础设施的网络风险治理提供可解释、可信赖的风险评估工具。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究针对关键基础设施的智能治理需求，将可解释AI与入侵检测结合，为安全分析师提供了透明、可信的风险评估方法，有助于提升对AI模型的信任并辅助决策。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于能源、医疗、交通等关键基础设施领域的入侵检测与风险量化场景，可迁移至其他需要可解释安全分析的环境。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究针对关键基础设施的智能治理需求，将可解释AI与入侵检测结合，为安全分析师提供了透明、可信的风险评估方法，有助于提升对AI模型的信任并辅助决策。

items.title: Cognitive Threat Intelligence and Explainable Federated Security Analytics for distributed Infrastructure Systems
items.summary: The increasing adoption of distributed infrastructure systems, cloud computing, Internet of Things (IoT) technologies, and edge-based architectures has significantly expanded the cybersecurity attack surface and introduced increasingly sophisticated cyber threats. Conventional centralized intrusion detection approaches often face challenges related to scalability, data privacy, communication overhead, and limited transparency in artificial intelligence-driven decision-making processes. To address these limitations, this study proposes a Cognitive Threat Intelligence and Explainable Federated Security Analytics framework for distributed infrastructure systems. The proposed framework integrates Federated Learning (FL), Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI), and cognitive cybersecurity analytics to enable collaborative and privacy-preserving cyber threat detection across distributed network environments. Instead of transmitting sensitive raw network traffic data to centralized servers, local security models are independently trained at distributed nodes, where only encrypted model parameters and updates are shared through a federated aggregation mechanism. This decentralized learning architecture improves privacy protection while reducing communication dependency and centralized security risks. To enhance intelligent threat analysis, the framework incorporates machine learning and deep learning algorithms including Random Forest, XGBoost, Autoencoder

llm_summary.summary_zh: 随着分布式基础设施系统（如云计算、物联网和边缘计算）的广泛采用，网络攻击面显著扩大，攻击手段也日益复杂。传统的集中式入侵检测方法在可扩展性、数据隐私、通信开销以及AI决策过程的透明度方面面临挑战。为解决这些问题，本文提出了一种认知威胁情报与可解释联邦安全分析框架。该框架融合了联邦学习（FL）、可解释人工智能（XAI）和认知网络安全分析，能够在分布式网络环境中实现协作式且隐私保护的网络威胁检测。具体来说，本地安全模型在分布式节点上独立训练，只有加密的模型参数和更新通过联邦聚合机制共享，从而避免了将敏感原始网络流量数据传输到中央服务器。这种去中心化学习架构增强了隐私保护，同时降低了通信依赖和集中式安全风险。为了提升智能威胁分析能力，框架集成了多种机器学习和深度学习算法，包括随机森林、XGBoost、自编码器等。论文通过实验验证了该框架在检测精度、通信效率、隐私保护性和可解释性方面的有效性。研究表明，该框架能够在保护数据隐私的前提下，实现高效的分布式威胁检测，并为安全分析师提供可解释的决策依据。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究针对分布式系统安全分析中的隐私和透明度痛点，提出联邦学习与XAI的实用结合方案，值得关注联邦安全分析或隐私保护威胁检测的从业者参考。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究针对分布式系统安全分析中的隐私和透明度痛点，提出联邦学习与XAI的实用结合方案，值得关注联邦安全分析或隐私保护威胁检测的从业者参考。

items.title: Beyond Waveform Robustness: Robust Feature-Vocoder Adversarial Attacks on Automatic Speech Recognition
items.summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems have become widely used for multilingual speech-to-text transcription. Their robustness to adversarial attacks has become an important topic for the community. Existing adversarial attacks directly add adversarial noise to the speech audio. However, prior work has shown that existing adversarial attacks face two limitations: they often transfer poorly to black-box ASR systems and are increasingly mitigated by defenses tailored to input-space perturbations. In this work, we propose a Clean-Referenced Feature-Vocoder Attack, a surrogate-based black-box attack that moves the adversarial search space from raw waveforms to self-supervised learning (SSL) representations. To address the transferability limitation, we perturb more generalizable acoustic-phonetic representations rather than low-level waveform samples, reducing dependence on surrogate-specific waveform gradients and encouraging adversarial perturbations that generalize across ASR systems. To bypass different defenses, we shift the adversarial signal from explicit additive waveform noise to SSL feature-space perturbations and reconstruct them through a vocoder into speech-like waveform adversarial signals, making the resulting samples less aligned with waveform-bounded defenses. Extensive experiments show that, when optimized only on raw Whisper-small as a public surrogate model, our attack transfers effectively to black-box ASR models with a +26.6 WER improvement over the SOTA baseline, while also remaining effective against multiple training defenses with a +36.2 WER improvement. These results reveal a blind spot in current ASR robustness evaluation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对自动语音识别（ASR）系统的对抗鲁棒性展开研究。现有对抗攻击主要通过在原始波形上直接添加扰动，但存在两大局限：一是对黑盒ASR系统的可迁移性较差，二是容易被针对输入空间扰动的防御机制所缓解。为解决这些问题，作者提出了一种名为Clean-Referenced Feature-Vocoder Attack的新型黑盒对抗攻击方法。其核心思想是将对抗搜索空间从原始波形转移到自监督学习（SSL）表示上。具体而言，该方法通过扰动更通用的声学-语音表示（即SSL特征），而非低级别的波形样本，从而减少对代理模型特定波形梯度的依赖，增强对抗扰动在不同ASR系统间的可迁移性。同时，通过将对抗信号从显式的加法波形噪声转变为SSL特征空间扰动，并借助声码器（vocoder）将其重建为类似语音的波形对抗信号，使得生成的样本与基于波形边界的防御机制不匹配，从而有效绕过多种防御。实验方面，仅在公开代理模型Whisper-small上进行优化，该攻击在黑盒ASR模型上实现了比当前最佳基线（SOTA）提升+26.6%的词错误率（WER），同时针对多种训练防御手段也保持了有效性，WER提升+36.2%。这些结果揭示了当前ASR鲁棒性评估中的盲区。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了现有ASR模型鲁棒性评估的盲区，提出了一种可迁移性更强且能绕过常见防御的黑盒攻击方法，对ASR安全研究具有重要指导意义。

items.why_it_matters: 揭示了现有ASR模型鲁棒性评估的盲区，提出了一种可迁移性更强且能绕过常见防御的黑盒攻击方法，对ASR安全研究具有重要指导意义。

items.title: Protecting K-Nearest Neighbor Queries from Location Inference Attacks
items.summary: The k-nearest neighbor query (kNNQ) is a core component of modern location-based services (LBS) and has been widely adopted in popular features such as ``people nearby''. However, its potential privacy risks have long been overlooked. In this work, we present the first two attacks against kNNQ, namely the geometric intersection location inference attack (GI-LIA) and the zero-order optimization location inference attack (ZO-LIA), revealing the inherent location privacy risks posed by kNNQ. To mitigate these privacy risks, we further propose DPRS, a differential privacy framework for kNNQ protection. The core idea of DPRS is to incorporate a rejection sampling mechanism within a constrained perturbation interval, thereby mitigating the distance distortion caused by excessive noise injection. In addition, we design a private interval construction algorithm to construct the perturbation interval, enabling the rejection sampling mechanism to achieve a more favorable trade-off between privacy protection and query utility in kNNQ. Extensive experiments on real-world spatial datasets demonstrate that DPRS outperforms existing methods in both privacy protection and query utility. Our code is available at https://github.com/reanatom/DPRS.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文关注位置服务中k近邻查询（kNNQ）的隐私风险。kNNQ广泛应用于“附近的人”等场景，但其隐私泄露问题长期被忽视。作者首先提出两种针对kNNQ的位置推理攻击：几何相交位置推理攻击（GI-LIA）和零阶优化位置推理攻击（ZO-LIA），揭示了kNNQ固有的位置隐私威胁。GI-LIA通过分析连续查询结果的几何关系推断用户精确位置，而ZO-LIA则利用黑盒优化方法逼近用户位置。为缓解这些风险，论文提出差分隐私框架DPRS。其核心思想是在约束扰动区间内引入拒绝采样机制，以减少过度噪声注入导致的距离失真。同时，设计了一个隐私区间构造算法来生成扰动区间，使拒绝采样机制在kNNQ中实现更好的隐私保护与查询效用权衡。在真实空间数据集上的实验表明，DPRS在隐私保护和查询效用方面均优于现有方法。代码已开源。本文适合位置隐私、差分隐私、移动安全领域的研究者和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次系统性揭示kNNQ固有的位置推理攻击风险，并提出实用的差分隐私防御方案，对LBS隐私保护具有重要参考价值。

items.why_it_matters: 首次系统性揭示kNNQ固有的位置推理攻击风险，并提出实用的差分隐私防御方案，对LBS隐私保护具有重要参考价值。

items.title: SlotGCG: Exploiting the Positional Vulnerability in LLMs for Jailbreak Attacks
items.summary: As large language models (LLMs) are widely deployed, identifying their vulnerability through jailbreak attacks becomes increasingly critical. Optimization-based attacks like Greedy Coordinate Gradient (GCG) have focused on inserting adversarial tokens to the end of prompts. However, GCG restricts adversarial tokens to a fixed insertion point (typically the prompt suffix), leaving the effect of inserting tokens at other positions unexplored. In this paper, we empirically investigate \emph{slots}, i.e., candidate positions within a prompt where tokens can be inserted. We find that vulnerability to jailbreaking is highly related to the selection of the \emph{slots}. Based on these findings, we introduce the \textit{Vulnerable Slot Score} (VSS) to quantify the positional vulnerability to jailbreaking. We then propose SlotGCG, which evaluates all slots with VSS, selects the most vulnerable slots for insertion, and runs a targeted optimization attack at those slots. Our approach provides a position-search mechanism that is attack-agnostic and can be plugged into any optimization-based attack, adding only 200ms of preprocessing time. Experiments across multiple models demonstrate that SlotGCG significantly outperforms existing methods. Specifically, it achieves 14\% higher Attack Success Rates (ASR) over GCG-based attacks, converges faster, and shows superior robustness against defense methods with 42\% higher ASR than baseline approaches. Our implementation is available at \href{https://github.com/youai058/SlotGCG}{https://github.com/youai058/SlotGCG}

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了大语言模型（LLM）在面对越狱攻击时的位置脆弱性。传统的基于优化的攻击方法（如贪婪坐标梯度下降 GCG）通常将对抗性 tokens 固定在提示语的末尾，忽略了在其他位置插入 tokens 的潜在影响。作者首先通过实验发现，提示语中不同的 token 插入位置（称为“槽位”）对越狱攻击的脆弱性高度相关。基于此，他们提出了脆弱槽位评分（VSS）来量化每个位置对越狱攻击的脆弱性。进一步，他们设计了 SlotGCG 方法：先使用 VSS 对所有候选槽位进行评估，选择最脆弱的槽位；然后在这些选定槽位上执行有针对性的优化攻击。SlotGCG 是一种攻击无关的位置搜索机制，可无缝集成到任何基于优化的攻击方法中，仅增加约 200 毫秒的预处理时间。在多个模型上的实验表明，SlotGCG 显著优于现有方法：与 GCG 基线相比，攻击成功率（ASR）提升 14%，收敛速度更快，且对防御方法的鲁棒性更强（ASR 比基线高 42%）。代码已开源。该工作揭示了 LLM 提示中位置维度的安全风险，为越狱攻击提供了新的研究视角。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了 LLM 提示中不同位置对越狱攻击的脆弱性差异，提出新的攻击优化方法，对理解模型安全隐患和设计防御策略有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可能降低现有 LLM 部署的安全性，使越狱攻击更高效、更难防御；同时为防御方案（如输入位置扰动、动态加噪）提供对抗用例。

items.why_it_matters: 揭示了 LLM 提示中不同位置对越狱攻击的脆弱性差异，提出新的攻击优化方法，对理解模型安全隐患和设计防御策略有重要参考价值。

items.title: Multi-Objective Submodular Maximization with Differential Privacy
items.summary: In this paper, we study multi-objective submodular maximization (MOSM) subject to a cardinality constraint under differential privacy (DP). Specifically, we aim to select a set of at most $k \in \mathbb{Z}_{+}$ elements to maximize the minimum of $d > 1$ monotone submodular functions while satisfying $\varepsilon$-DP. Although extensive studies have been conducted on both differentially private single-objective submodular maximization on sensitive data and non-private MOSM, to the best of our knowledge, there has not yet been any prior work on MOSM with DP. We propose two novel algorithms: the first extends the classic greedy algorithm and the second employs a truncation technique, both of which are integrated with DP mechanisms for privacy protection and achieve approximation guarantees for MOSM. Finally, we conduct numerical experiments on two submodular maximization applications, namely maximum coverage and facility location, in multi-objective settings to validate the efficacy and efficiency of our proposed algorithms.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了在差分隐私（DP）约束下，针对基数约束的多目标子模最大化（MOSM）问题。子模最大化在机器学习和数据挖掘中广泛应用，例如最大覆盖和设施选址问题，但现有工作大多考虑单目标优化或非隐私场景。本文首次将差分隐私引入多目标子模最大化，旨在从敏感数据中选择至多k个元素，以最大化d个单调子模函数的最小值，同时满足ε-差分隐私。我们提出了两种新颖算法：第一种算法扩展了经典贪心算法，通过逐轮选择元素并添加拉普拉斯噪声实现隐私保护，但需要调整目标函数以平衡多个目标；第二种算法采用截断技术，对每个目标函数的增益进行截断后再应用贪心选择，并融入差分隐私机制，从而提供更稳定的近似保证。理论分析证明，两种算法均能达到近似最优解，并保持了差分隐私的隐私预算。数值实验在两个典型应用（多目标最大覆盖和多目标设施选址）上进行，验证了算法在效用和效率上的有效性。实验结果表明，与基准方法相比，所提算法在隐私参数适中时仍能保持较高的目标函数值，且运行时间可接受。本文为数据敏感场景下的组合优化提供了新视角，适合对隐私保护、子模优化及相关领域感兴趣的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 差分隐私是保护敏感数据的关键技术，而子模最大化广泛用于特征选择、资源分配等安全任务。本文首次将两者结合到多目标场景，为蓝队在使用用户数据优化多个安全目标（如检测覆盖率与误报率）时提供隐私保护理论基础。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于隐私保护的传感器布置、安全日志分析中的多目标特征选取、以及数据驱动的入侵检测系统参数调优等场景。

items.why_it_matters: 差分隐私是保护敏感数据的关键技术，而子模最大化广泛用于特征选择、资源分配等安全任务。本文首次将两者结合到多目标场景，为蓝队在使用用户数据优化多个安全目标（如检测覆盖率与误报率）时提供隐私保护理论基础。

items.title: The Coverage Gap: Chile's Cyber Disclosure Framework versus the USA, EU and UK
items.summary: We introduce the Coverage Gap as a measurable distance between the observable public exposure of critical-infrastructure operators and their declared capability to coordinate vulnerability disclosure. We instantiate it against the 915 Chilean Operadores de Importancia Vital (OIVs -- Operators of Vital Importance) designated by the National Cybersecurity Agency (ANCI) under Ley 21.663 (Resolucion Exenta No. 87, 16 December 2025). Using a passive-only, OSINT-based method consistent with the principles of ISO/IEC 29147:2018 and Chile's computer-crimes safe harbour (Ley 21.459), we conduct a full-universe census of the foundational disclosure-capability layer (Layer 1, verifiable disclosure contact) across approximately 98.7% of the official catalogue. Only 16 of 915 OIVs (1.7%) publish a verifiable RFC 9116 disclosure channel; among operators of physical-world infrastructure -- energy, health, banking, telecommunications, fuel, water, transport, and state administration -- fewer than ten do so, and all four major banks and both telecommunications incumbents lack one entirely. This compares with over 99% adherence in the U.S. federal civilian branch under CISA Binding Operational Directive 18-01. Email-authentication misconfiguration affects 766 of 915 (84%) OIVs, and end-of-life or known-vulnerable stack components an estimated 23.5% (Wilson 95% CI [12%, 38%]). Cross-jurisdictional benchmarking situates Chile roughly eight years behind the USA, the UK, and the Netherlands on email-authentication mandates, and three years behind Denmark. We propose a four-stage roadmap modelled on BOD 18-01 and the UK Public-Sector DMARC Toolkit, and release the open-source tool anci-oiv-resolver (Apache 2.0) to enable independent reproduction of the OIV-domain mapping that underpins universe-scale auditing.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了“覆盖缺口”（Coverage Gap）概念，用以衡量关键基础设施运营商在公共暴露面与漏洞披露能力之间的可量化差距。作者以智利国家网络安全局（ANCI）根据第21.663号法律指定的915家重要运营商（OIV）为研究对象，采用仅基于被动OSINT的方法，遵循ISO/IEC 29147:2018标准以及智利计算机犯罪安全港法规（第21.459号法律），对官方目录中约98.7%的运营商进行了基础披露能力层（第1层，即可验证的披露联系渠道）的全量普查。结果显示，仅有16家（1.7%）发布可验证的RFC 9116披露渠道；在物理世界基础设施运营商（能源、医疗、银行、电信、燃料、水务、交通及国家行政）中，少于10家拥有该渠道，且所有四大银行及两家主要电信公司完全缺失。相比之下，美国联邦民事部门在CISA约束性操作指令18-01下的合规率超过99%。此外，84%的运营商存在电子邮件认证配置错误，约23.5%使用了已终止支持或已知存在漏洞的堆栈组件（Wilson 95% CI [12%, 38%]）。跨司法管辖区基准比较显示，智利在电子邮件认证强制要求方面落后美国、英国、荷兰约八年，落后丹麦约三年。作者提出了基于BOD 18-01和英国公共部门DMARC工具包的四阶段路线图，并发布了开源工具anci-oiv-resolver（Apache 2.0），支持独立复现支撑全量审计的OIV域名映射。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了关键基础设施在漏洞披露能力上的系统性缺失，为各国评估和提升网络安全协调能力提供了可复现的测量方法和基准数据。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响智利关键基础设施运营商的漏洞管理实践，方法论可迁移至其他国家的类似评估。

items.title: Dimensionality Reduction for Cyberattack Classification: A Comparative Evaluation of PCA and Linear Predictive Coding
items.summary: High-dimensional feature representations are widely used in machine learning-based cyberattack detection systems. However, they increase computational complexity and may hinder deployment in resource-constrained environments. In this paper, we investigate feature compression techniques for cyberattack classification by comparing two dimensionality reduction approaches: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and Linear Predictive Coding (LPC). Compressed feature representations with varying dimensionalities are generated and evaluated across several classification models. Experimental analysis demonstrates that PCA preserves classification performance even under aggressive compression. On the other hand, LPC provides competitive predictive representations with slightly larger performance degradation. The results show that substantial reductions in feature dimensionality can be achieved with minimal impact on classification accuracy, highlighting the potential of lightweight feature compression for efficient cybersecurity analytics.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对网络安全攻击检测中高维特征表示导致的计算复杂度和资源消耗问题，研究了两种降维方法——主成分分析（PCA）和线性预测编码（LPC）在攻击分类中的效果。作者通过生成不同维度的压缩特征表示，并在多个分类模型（如SVM、随机森林等）上进行评估，实验表明PCA在激进压缩下仍能保持分类性能，而LPC也提供了有竞争力的预测表示，虽然性能略有下降。结果显示，在分类精度影响极小的情况下，可以大幅降低特征维度，从而为资源受限环境下的轻量级网络安全分析提供了可行方案。该研究为特征压缩技术在入侵检测系统中的应用提供了比较基准，适合从事机器学习安全应用的研究人员和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 高维特征在现实网络监控中带来计算瓶颈，本文系统比较PCA与LPC两种降维方法在攻击分类中的效能，为构建轻量级检测系统提供了量化依据。

items.title: ZERO-APT: A Closed-Loop Adversarial Framework for LLM-Driven Automated Penetration Testing under Intelligent Defense
items.summary: LLM-driven automated penetration testing agents are typically evaluated against static targets that neither detect nor respond to attacks, so their behavior under intelligent defense remains untested. The causal consistency of multi-step attack chains likewise hinges on unstable LLM reasoning, and agent decisions remain opaque to human analysts. These three shortcomings, in realism, consistency, and auditability, are usually patched in isolation. We present ZERO-APT, a turn-based attacker-defender-judge framework that addresses them within a single architecture. For realism, ZERO-APT embeds a configurable LLM Defender that consumes Sysmon telemetry and detects attacks in real time, exposing the attacker to a live opponent rather than a passive target. For consistency, three architectural mechanisms move causal consistency from unstable LLM reasoning into enforced system architecture: separation of planning from execution, multi-dimensional ReAct feedback, and a hard-constraint-filtered action library. For auditability, a dedicated Judge agent adjudicates each round, maintains global state, and emits structured post-hoc CTI reports that make every decision traceable. We evaluate a Windows Server 2022 post-exploitation prototype across five scenarios with three Defender configurations. ZERO-APT reaches 79\% attack success rate (Aurora 22\%, PentestGPT 39\%), a Causal Consistency Score of 0.860 (Aurora 0.930, Claude Code 0.520), and end-to-end decision auditability through structured CTI reports. We release the benchmark to support evaluation of penetration agents under intelligent defense.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出ZERO-APT，一个面向LLM驱动的自动渗透测试智能体的闭环对抗框架。现有评估通常在静态目标上进行，目标既不检测也不响应攻击，导致智能体在智能防御下的行为未经测试。此外，多步攻击链的因果一致性依赖于不稳定的LLM推理，且智能体决策对分析师不透明。ZERO-APT通过一个回合制的攻击者-防御者-裁判框架同时解决这三个问题：真实性方面，嵌入可配置的LLM防御者，利用Sysmon遥测实时检测攻击，使攻击者面对活对手而非被动目标；一致性方面，通过规划与执行分离、多维ReAct反馈、硬约束过滤动作库三种机制将因果一致性从不稳定LLM推理转移到强制系统架构中；可审计性方面，专用裁判智能体裁决每轮行动、维护全局状态并生成结构化事后CTI报告，使每个决策可追溯。在Windows Server 2022后渗透原型上，使用三种防御者配置评估五个场景，ZERO-APT达到79%攻击成功率（对比Aurora 22%、PentestGPT 39%），因果一致性得分0.860（Aurora 0.930、Claude Code 0.520），并通过结构化CTI报告实现端到端决策可审计。作者发布了基准测试以支持智能防御下的渗透智能体评估。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究首次在统一框架中同时评估LLM渗透智能体面对智能防御的真实性、因果一致性和可审计性，为开发更鲁棒的自动化渗透测试工具提供了重要基准和方法。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 对LLM驱动的安全自动化评估具有开创性，可迁移到红队演练、安全测试平台构建及AI辅助攻防研究。

items.title: GuardNet: Ensemble Strategies of Shallow Neural Networks for Robust Prompt Injection and Jailbreak Detection
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have transformed natural language processing, but they remain vulnerable to Prompt Injection (PI) and Jailbreak (JB) attacks. In addition, benchmark evaluations may be affected by contamination and partial information leakage, compromising performance estimates. This work presents GuardNet, a guardrail system based on an ensemble of shallow neural networks (BiLSTMs) with approximately 47 million parameters. We investigate the hypothesis that robustness in adversarial scenarios depends more on the diversity of example coverage and threshold calibration than on model scale. The results indicate that GuardNet achieves competitive performance compared with lightweight detectors and high efficiency at low latency, although larger LLMs such as Mistral-7B and Llama-3.1-8B still achieve superior performance in terms of F1 score and AUROC on the blind JBB-Behaviors benchmark. Nevertheless, GuardNet achieves an AUROC of 0.747 on the blind dataset (n = 200) and an F1 score of 0.92 on a proprietary benchmark (n = 50), under threshold calibration and evaluation with declared partial information leakage. The system operates with an average latency of approximately 50 ms on CPU, making it suitable for deployment in production environments with cost and infrastructure constraints.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在自然语言处理领域取得了突破，但仍面临提示注入（Prompt Injection, PI）和越狱攻击（Jailbreak, JB）的严重威胁。现有基准评测可能受到数据污染和部分信息泄露的影响，导致性能估计不准确。本文提出 GuardNet，一种基于浅层神经网络（BiLSTM）集成的护栏系统，模型参数约 4700 万。研究假设：对抗场景下的鲁棒性更多依赖于示例覆盖的多样性和阈值校准，而非模型规模。实验结果表明，GuardNet 在盲测数据集 JBB-Behaviors（n=200）上 AUROC 达到 0.747，在专有基准（n=50）上 F1 分数达 0.92（在阈值校准和已声明的部分信息泄露条件下）。尽管 Mistral-7B 和 Llama-3.1-8B 等更大模型在 F1 和 AUROC 上仍更优，但 GuardNet 在 CPU 上平均延迟仅约 50 毫秒，非常适合成本和基础设施受限的生产环境部署。文章详细介绍了集成策略、阈值校准方法以及部分信息泄露对评测的影响，为轻量级防御系统提供了新思路。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 低延迟、轻量级的提示注入/越狱检测方案对实际部署至关重要，GuardNet 展示了在有限资源下仍能保持较好检测能力，适合安全运营团队集成到 LLM 应用防护中。

items.title: On the Cryptographic Structure Required for Verifying Qubits
items.summary: Classically testing for the presence of anti-commuting operators on a quantum device is a critical tool underpinning recent progress in classical verification of quantum computation. While such tests can be based on cryptographic assumptions, known constructions rely on highly structured assumptions, e.g. trapdoor claw-free functions. In this work, we seek to explain this state of affairs by constructing strong cryptography from (certain forms of) classical tests of anti-commutation. In particular, we formulate the notion of a test of non-commutation (ToNC), an interactive protocol between a quantum prover and classical verifier in which the prover's final-round response is obtained by measuring one of two binary observables $P_0,P_1$ depending on the verifier's challenge bit $c$. We prove that, for a broad range of parameters, ToNC implies classical-communication key agreement (KA), and ToNC combined with one-way functions implies oblivious transfer (OT). Along the way, we develop tools for and provide the first known results on hardness amplification for post-quantum KA and OT, where communication is classical but adversaries may be quantum. In particular, we prove the following results of independent interest. - Post-quantum hard-core measure theorem: For any efficiently sampleable high-min-entropy distribution $D$ over pairs $(x,b)$ such that quantum circuits have advantage at most $δ$ in predicting $b$ from $x$, there exists a sub-distribution $M\preceq D$ of density $(1-δ)$ on which $b$ is nearly optimally quantum-hard to predict. - Post-quantum interactive XOR lemma: Given any classically-interactive protocol, if quantum adversaries have advantage at most $δ$ in guessing a private challenger bit $b$, then two sequential repetitions reduce the advantage for predicting the XOR of the challenger bits $b_1\oplus b_2$ to at most $δ^2+\rm{negl}(λ)$.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究经典验证量子计算（classical verification of quantum computation）所需的加密结构基础。经典验证量子计算是近年来的重要进展，其核心工具之一是经典测试量子设备中是否存在反交换算子（anti-commuting operators）。现有的此类测试通常依赖于强加密假设（如陷阱门无爪函数）。本文试图解释这一现状，并证明从经典的反交换测试可以构造出强加密原语。具体而言，论文形式化提出了“非交换测试”（Test of Non-Commutation, ToNC）概念：它是一种量子证明者与经典验证者之间的交互协议，证明者根据验证者的挑战比特c选择测量两个二元可观测量P0或P1之一，并返回测量结果。论文证明，在广泛参数下，ToNC蕴含经典通信的密钥协商（Key Agreement, KA）；而ToNC与单向函数结合则能构造不经意传输（Oblivious Transfer, OT）。此外，论文还发展了对后量子KA和OT（通信经典但敌手量子）的hardness amplification技术，取得两项独立成果：（1）后量子硬核测度定理：对于任何高效可采样的高最小熵分布D（其中量子电路预测b的优越性至多为δ），存在密度为(1-δ)的子分布M，其上b近乎最优的量子硬预测；（2）后量子交互XOR引理：对于任何经典交互协议，若量子敌手猜测私密挑战比特b的优越性至多为δ，则两次顺序重复将猜测挑战比特异或b1⊕b2的优越性降低至最多δ²+可忽略项。这些结果为经典验证量子计算与量子安全密码学之间建立了深层联系。适合理论密码学家、量子计算研究者、后量子安全协议设计者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了经典验证量子计算与基础密码原语（密钥协商、不经意传输）之间的内在联系，为设计更高效或假设更弱的量子安全协议提供了理论支撑。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 理论贡献，可能影响未来量子安全密码系统的安全性证明和协议设计。

items.title: Bitcoin After Block Rewards
items.summary: Bitcoin's block reward is scheduled to decline to zero, raising concerns about whether the network can remain secure once miners rely solely on transaction fees. This paper seeks to identify the conditions under which large-scale and persistent deviation from honest mining can arise. We analyze and compare the payoffs of honest and deviating miners in a sequential decision model, and identify a deviation threshold $G_t$ at which honest mining ceases to be privately optimal. Around the 2024 Bitcoin halving, we show that current mining behavior does not exhibit large-scale or structural deviation. However, when the block reward is removed, the $G_t$ criterion implies that deviation can arise even with a very small fraction of transaction fees. Finally, we evaluate three protocol-level mechanisms: Base Fee, Fee Floor, and an adaptive maximum block size rule, and show that their combination raises the deviation threshold and mitigates incentive breakdown in a fee-only regime. These results provide a practical benchmark for assessing Bitcoin's security as block rewards disappear.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文研究比特币区块奖励逐步归零后网络的安全性问题。随着比特币每四年减半，区块奖励最终将消失，矿工仅依赖交易手续费获得收益，这可能引发激励不相容问题，导致大规模挖矿偏离诚实行为。作者构建了一个序贯决策模型，比较诚实挖矿与偏离挖矿的收益，定义了偏差阈值 G_t，当该阈值下降时诚实挖矿不再是矿工的私有最优策略。利用2024年减半前后的数据，发现当前挖矿行为未出现结构性偏离。但模型表明，一旦区块奖励移除，即使手续费占比很小，偏差也可能出现。论文评估了三种协议级机制：基础费（Base Fee）、手续费下限（Fee Floor）和自适应最大区块大小规则，发现三者组合可显著提高偏差阈值，缓解纯手续费机制下的激励崩溃。研究为评估比特币长期安全性提供了理论基准，适合区块链研究者、加密货币经济学者及核心开发者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 比特币最终转向纯手续费模式，其安全性完全依赖于交易费用激励，一旦激励失衡可能导致链上重组攻击泛滥。本文首次给出了量化偏差阈值及可行缓解方案，对理解未来比特币安全演化至关重要。

items.title: SHIELDS: Automating OS Hardening with Iterative Multi-Agent Remediation
items.summary: Security misconfigurations remain a leading cause of OS-level compromise, and manually keeping systems compliant with standards like Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) is a tedious and expensive process. Existing compliance automation tools can reduce some of this burden, but they depend on static, pre-written corrective actions. In this paper, we introduce SHIELDS, a multi-agent system that uses large language models (LLMs) to approach OS hardening as an iterative, feedback-driven process. Instead of applying fixed remediations, SHIELDS continuously proposes fixes and refines them based on feedback from target system execution and validation scans. We evaluate the system across multiple virtual machine configurations using six contemporary LLMs ranging from 20B to 400B parameters, and find that SHIELDS successfully remediates up to 73% of scan findings. Our results also suggest that success in this setting depends less on model size (parameter count) than on effective tool use and information gathering, paving a practical path toward reducing the burden of security compliance in environments where compute is limited or security and privacy needs drive local model use.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 这篇论文提出了 SHIELDS，一个基于多智能体和大语言模型的自动化操作系统加固系统。针对安全配置错误这一导致系统被攻破的主要原因，传统方法依赖人工或静态预定义的修复脚本，效率低下且难以适应多样化环境。SHIELDS 将操作系统加固建模为一个迭代的、反馈驱动的过程：系统由多个 LLM 驱动的智能体组成，首先扫描目标系统以发现不符合 DISA STIGs 等安全基线的问题，然后自动生成修复方案并执行，接着重新扫描验证修复效果，若未完全修复则根据反馈调整修复策略，直到达到预期合规状态。实验在多种虚拟机配置上进行，使用了 6 种不同规模（20B 至 400B 参数）的当代 LLM。结果表明，SHIELDS 平均能修复高达 73% 的扫描发现的问题，并且修复成功率与模型参数规模相关性较弱，而更依赖于智能体能否有效利用工具和处理信息。这表明在计算资源受限或对数据隐私要求高的环境中，使用较小模型也能取得良好效果，为降低安全合规维护成本提供了新路径。主要贡献在于：1）提出了一种无需预设修复脚本的迭代加固框架；2）通过多智能体协作实现了自适应的修复策略生成；3）揭示了模型大小并非决定安全自动化效果的关键因素。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 传统 OS 加固依赖人工或静态脚本，难以规模化。SHIELDS 提供了一种基于 LLM 的自动化迭代方案，可显著降低安全配置管理的成本和复杂度，且不依赖大模型，适合资源受限或隐私敏感环境。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于企业级安全基线合规自动化（如 DISA STIGs、CIS Benchmarks）、云服务器批量加固、边缘设备安全配置管理等场景。

items.title: CRESS: Quantifying Vulnerabilities of Attack Scenarios in Hardware Reverse Engineering
items.summary: The safety, security, and reliability of microelectronic systems depend on a trustworthy, secured supply chain and design flow. Globally distributed supply chains or unintentional design weaknesses leave the door open for attacks on the hardware level. These scenarios encompass counterfeiting, hardware trojans, or on-device attacks. For these, hardware reverse engineering (RE) results play a pivotal role. The ongoing publication of new RE-involved attacks motivated the development of the common RE scoring system (CRESS). The system enables a general classification of RE-involved scenarios for a common, consistent rating. In this work, the originally qualitative system is extended to a quantitative system. We performed an extensive interview study with experts in the field. The interview results allowed us to derive weights that measure the severity of different RE-involved attack categories. The weights form an equation that quantifies scenarios, resulting in the severity-indicating CRESS score. The score enables the coherent rating of novel scenarios, renders them comparable, and supports the development of effective countermeasures. To showcase the effectiveness of the quantitative CRESS Score, six selected case studies are rated qualitatively and quantitatively. The CRESS Score proves to be significantly more expressive than the industry-standard Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS).

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了CRESS（Common RE Scoring System）的量化扩展版本，用于评估硬件逆向工程（RE）攻击场景的严重性。硬件逆向工程在微电子系统的安全中扮演关键角色，涉及假冒、硬件木马、设备上攻击等。现有的CVSS（Common Vulnerability Scoring System）行业标准在评估RE相关场景时表现不足，因为其设计初衷并非针对硬件RE。CRESS原本是一个定性分类系统，本文通过领域专家访谈研究，推导出不同RE攻击类别的权重，形成量化评分方程，从而得到CRESS分数。该分数能够对新型场景进行一致评级，使其具有可比性，并支持制定有效的防御措施。通过六个案例研究，定性和定量评估验证了CRESS分数的有效性，证明其比CVSS更具表达力。适合硬件安全研究人员、芯片设计安全工程师、供应链安全评估人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 硬件逆向工程攻击是芯片供应链安全的重要威胁，现有CVSS无法准确评估此类风险。CRESS量化评分填补了这一空白，为安全分析师提供更精准的度量工具。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，评估将CRESS集成到内部硬件安全评估流程的可行性

items.title: DP-MacAdam: Differentially Private Mechanism with Adaptive Clipping and Adaptive Momentum
items.summary: Differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) has become the standard framework for privacy-preserving machine learning, yet its reliance on a fixed gradient clipping threshold to limit sensitivity remains a significant practical limitation. Adaptive clipping algorithms such as AdaClip shift and scale the gradient prior to clipping and adding noise so that the clipped gradient yields a more informative descent direction. The shift and scaling parameters are selected adaptively based on the empirical mean and variance. However, in existing adaptive clipping algorithms, these empirical estimates have not been also used for momentum to accelerate training itself. On the other hand, DP-Adam is an algorithm that exploits Adam-like momentum updates based on the gradient mean and variance to accelerate training, but does not exploit these estimates for adaptive clipping. In this work, we propose Differentially Private Mechanism with Adaptive Clipping and Adaptive Momentum (DP-MacAdam), a novel algorithm that combines these two approaches so as to use the same mean and variance estimates for both clipping and momentum. We perform an analysis showing that DP-MacAdam estimates the gradient variances in a bias-free manner. In addition, we empirically evaluate the privacy and accuracy of DP-MacAdam, demonstrating that it achieves improved model utility compared to DP-SGD, AdaClip, and DP-Adam baselines, without requiring manual tuning of the clipping threshold.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为 DP-MacAdam 的新型差分隐私机制，旨在解决差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）中固定裁剪阈值带来的局限性。现有的自适应裁剪算法（如 AdaClip）根据梯度的经验均值和方差自适应调整裁剪参数，但未将这些估计用于动量加速；而 DP-Adam 利用 Adam 风格的动量更新加速训练，却未利用梯度估计进行自适应裁剪。DP-MacAdam 创新地将自适应裁剪与自适应动量相结合，使用相同的均值和方差估计同时指导裁剪和动量更新，从而在保护隐私的同时提升模型效用。理论分析表明，DP-MacAdam 能无偏估计梯度方差。实验评估在多个数据集上显示，与 DP-SGD、AdaClip 和 DP-Adam 等基线相比，DP-MacAdam 在同等隐私预算下实现了更高的模型精度，且无需手动调整裁剪阈值。该方法适用于需要差分隐私保护的机器学习场景，尤其适合数据敏感领域（如医疗、金融）中的模型训练。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为隐私保护机器学习提供了更高效的自适应算法，有助于在满足差分隐私要求的同时提升模型性能，降低工程调参成本。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 主要影响差分隐私模型训练领域，可迁移至任何使用 DP-SGD 的隐私保护机器学习场景，如联邦学习、私有推理等。

items.why_it_matters: 为隐私保护机器学习提供了更高效的自适应算法，有助于在满足差分隐私要求的同时提升模型性能，降低工程调参成本。

items.title: Policy-Compliant Cloud Storage Systems
items.summary: Privacy regulations such as the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) impose strict requirements on how personal data is stored, processed, and audited. While key-value stores (KVS) are widely used in latency-sensitive applications, their simple data model and untrusted cloud deployment environments make GDPR compliance particularly challenging. Existing approaches require invasive code modifications, impose high performance overheads, or overlook the integrity of compliance mechanisms themselves. This paper presents GDPRuler, a trusted middleware system that enables verifiable GDPR compliance for KVS on untrusted clouds without modifying their codebase. GDPRuler deploys a trusted GDPR monitor inside a Confidential Virtual Machine (CVM), which enforces GDPR policies, manages compliance metadata, and maintains tamper-evident audit logs. A declarative policy language translates core GDPR obligations into enforceable runtime rules. To ensure efficiency, GDPRuler encodes metadata compactly within KV records, builds dedicated metadata indexes for GDPR-specific queries, and logs only compliance-relevant events in a space-efficient format. We implement GDPRuler as a transparent proxy for unmodified Redis and RocksDB deployments. Evaluation with YCSB and GDPR-inspired workloads shows that GDPRuler enforces core compliance guarantees with low overheads: GDPRuler achieves ~61% of native KVS throughput with the CVM environment contributing 28%-32% of it, metadata storage overhead remains below 20%, and GDPR queries benefit from 13-182x speedup through metadata indexing. By embedding verifiable policy enforcement into a trusted middleware layer, GDPRuler offers a practical path toward GDPR-compliant KVS on untrusted cloud infrastructures.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对在不可信云环境中部署键值存储（KVS）时如何满足GDPR等隐私法规的合规要求问题，提出了一种名为GDPRuler的可信中间件系统。GDPRuler通过将合规监视器部署在机密虚拟机（CVM）内，以透明代理的方式拦截KVS请求，在不修改Redis或RocksDB等现有KVS代码的前提下，强制执行GDPR策略、管理合规元数据并维护防篡改审计日志。系统设计包括：声明性策略语言将核心GDPR义务转换为可执行的运行时规则；紧凑的元数据编码方式嵌入KV记录中；专用元数据索引加速GDPR相关查询；仅记录合规相关事件以节省存储空间。实验基于YCSB和GDPR模拟工作负载进行，结果表明GDPRuler在实现核心合规保证的同时，性能开销较低：吞吐量达到原生KVS的约61%，其中CVM环境贡献了28%-32%的吞吐量；元数据存储开销低于20%；通过元数据索引，GDPR查询加速了13-182倍。该研究为在不可信云基础设施上构建符合GDPR的KVS提供了一条实用路径。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 当前云上KVS普遍缺乏对GDPR等隐私法规的内生支持，GDPRuler以低侵入、低开销的方式提供了可验证的合规方案，对依赖云存储的企业和安全工程师具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于所有使用KVS的云应用，尤其是需要处理个人数据的场景，如在线零售、社交网络、金融服务等。

items.why_it_matters: 当前云上KVS普遍缺乏对GDPR等隐私法规的内生支持，GDPRuler以低侵入、低开销的方式提供了可验证的合规方案，对依赖云存储的企业和安全工程师具有直接参考价值。

items.title: A formal framework for the economic security of DeFi compositions
items.summary: Decentralized Finance (DeFi) services are usually constructed by composing a variety of smart contracts. While composability is a key driver of the success of DeFi, it also creates security risks: adversaries may exploit interactions between newly deployed contracts and the pre-existing ones to inflict economic losses. We introduce MEV non-interference, a formal security notion for DeFi composability requiring that the maximal extractable value from a set of newly deployed contracts is not increased by interactions with the existing blockchain state. To support this notion, we define local MEV, a novel measure of economic attacks that focusses on the loss of a given set of victim contracts. We study two adversarial models, with bounded and unbounded wealth, and establish sufficient conditions and locality principles that enable modular reasoning about secure composability. We apply the framework to representative DeFi compositions, including exchanges, AMMs, options, lending pools, routers, and arbitrage contracts, showing how it distinguishes secure compositions from vulnerable ones. Our results provide a formal foundation for reasoning about the economic security of DeFi compositions.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出一个形式化框架用于分析DeFi组合的经济安全性。DeFi服务通常由多个智能合约组合而成，这种组合性在带来灵活性的同时也引入了安全风险：攻击者可能利用新部署合约与现有合约之间的交互来造成经济损失。为此，作者引入了MEV非干扰性（MEV non-interference）这一形式化安全概念，要求新部署合约集合的最大可提取价值（MEV）不会因与现有区块链状态的交互而增加。为了支撑这一概念，他们定义了局部MEV（local MEV），一种聚焦于特定受害者合约集合经济损失的新型经济攻击度量。研究考虑了有限财富和无限财富两种对手模型，并建立了充分条件和局部性原理，从而支持对安全组合性的模块化推理。框架被应用于多种代表性DeFi组合场景，包括交易所、自动做市商（AMM）、期权、借贷池、路由器和套利合约，展示了如何区分安全组合与脆弱组合。实验结果证明了该框架的有效性。该工作为DeFi组合的经济安全性推理提供了形式化基础，适合DeFi安全研究者、协议开发者及审计人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: DeFi组合的经济安全是当前区块链安全的核心挑战之一。该框架首次形式化定义了MEV非干扰性，为识别和预防组合攻击提供了理论工具，有助于提升DeFi协议的整体安全性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接适用于DeFi协议设计与审计中的经济安全分析，未来可扩展至跨链组合、Layer2等更复杂场景。

items.why_it_matters: DeFi组合的经济安全是当前区块链安全的核心挑战之一。该框架首次形式化定义了MEV非干扰性，为识别和预防组合攻击提供了理论工具，有助于提升DeFi协议的整体安全性。

items.title: Willing but Unable: Separating Refusal from Capability in Code LLMs via Abliteration
items.summary: Producing a labeled vulnerable code at scale is a recurring obstacle for learning-based vulnerability detection: mined corpora carry substantial label noise, and existing LLM-based augmentation propagates these inaccuracies because it transforms vulnerable seeds rather than synthesising vulnerabilities from a specification. A complementary route is to start from safe code and ask an instruction-tuned LLM to inject a specified CWE (which would shift the labeling burden from open-ended detection to bounded binary confirmation) but safety-aligned code LLMs systematically refuse such prompts. This paper is a preliminary feasibility study of abliteration, a low-rank weight edit that orthogonally projects out the refusal direction in the residual stream, as a tool to remove this barrier. We use Python and CWE-89 (SQL injection) as a case study, evaluating the Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct family at 3B, 7B, and 14B parameters on safe samples drawn from PromSec and SafeCoder, replicated three times per condition. We find that (i) refusal on injection prompts is strongly size- and prompt-context-dependent: the 14B refuses 100% of prompts, the 7B refuses 73% of PromSec but only 5% of SafeCoder, whereas the 3B is essentially never blocked; (ii) abliteration reduces refusal to zero or near-zero across all sizes while leaving syntactic validity above 93%, supporting the view that, in this setting, refusal can be detached from measured code-generation capability; and (iii) the post-abliteration injection rate remains capacity-bound (88-97% on the 14B, 89-90% on the 7B, and 25-48% on the 3B) separating willingness, which abliteration unlocks, from capability, which scales with parameters. Vulnerability verdicts are produced by a three-tool detector ensemble (CodeQL, Semgrep, Bandit) followed by manual adjudication by two authors on detector-positive outputs.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对基于学习的漏洞检测中标记数据瓶颈问题，提出利用abliteration技术解除安全对齐代码LLM的拒绝响应限制，使其能够根据指定CWE（如SQL注入）从安全代码生成带漏洞样本，从而将标注负担从开放式检测转为有界二元确认。作者以Python和CWE-89为案例，在Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct模型系列（3B、7B、14B参数）上，使用PromSec和SafeCoder数据集进行三重复实验。研究发现：(i) 模型对注入提示的拒绝行为与大小和上下文密切相关：14B模型完全拒绝，7B在PromSec上拒绝73%但在SafeCoder上仅5%，3B几乎从不拒绝；(ii) ablitation（低秩权重正交投影去除残差流中的拒绝方向）可将拒绝率降至零或接近零，同时保持93%以上的语法有效性，表明在此场景下拒绝能力可与代码生成能力解耦；(iii) 注入率受限于模型容量：14B达88-97%，7B为89-90%，3B仅25-48%，揭示了ablitation解锁的是“意愿”而非“能力”。漏洞判定由CodeQL、Semgrep、Bandit三工具集成检测后经人工裁定。该研究为大规模高质量漏洞数据集生成提供了新方向。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作解决了安全对齐代码LLM拒绝协助漏洞注入的障碍，为自动化生成带标签漏洞样本提供了可行方案，有助于缓解漏洞检测数据集标注噪声问题。

items.why_it_matters: 该工作解决了安全对齐代码LLM拒绝协助漏洞注入的障碍，为自动化生成带标签漏洞样本提供了可行方案，有助于缓解漏洞检测数据集标注噪声问题。

items.title: Preserving Data Privacy in Learning Causal Structure with Fully Homomorphic Encryption
items.summary: Preserving data privacy is an important topic in structural data management and data mining. However, the issue of privacy leakage in distributed causal structure learning is a persistent challenge, especially in cases where data transmission and computation are required. In this paper, we propose a method based on fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) that performs calculations on ciphertexts, keeping data encrypted in transition and computation. Nevertheless, adopting FHE to causal structure learning is challenging due to the high computation cost and limited support on division as well as logarithm operations in FHE. To tackle this challenge, we propose a series of novel techniques including (i) circuit simplification for better efficiency, (ii) approximation of division and logarithm through Newton-Raphson Reciprocal and Taylor expansion, and (iii) a batching technique with SIMD-acceleration to enhance the whole learning process. Additionally, our method can be easily extended beyond FHE by demonstration of its portability to support differential privacy. Empirical results show that our method achieves high consistency and comparable causal structure with the plaintext version in the datasets tested. Last, our method is efficient and practical to complete learning causal structures in tens of minutes even under the privacy protection of FHE.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对分布式因果结构学习中的数据隐私泄露问题，提出了一种基于全同态加密（FHE）的隐私保护方法。因果结构学习旨在从数据中推断变量间的因果关系，在分布式场景下，各参与方需交换中间结果，容易导致隐私泄漏。传统加密方案无法同时保证计算过程中的数据机密性和可操作性，而FHE允许在密文上直接计算，但直接应用于因果结构学习面临计算开销大、不支持除法和对数运算等挑战。为此，作者提出了三项关键技术：(i) 电路简化技术，通过优化计算电路提升效率；(ii) 利用牛顿-拉夫森倒数法和泰勒展开近似除法和对数运算，使FHE能够支持因果结构学习所需的基本运算；(iii) 采用单指令多数据（SIMD）加速的批处理技术，将多个操作并行化，显著降低整体计算时间。此外，该方法易于扩展，可通过差分隐私进一步增强隐私保护。实验结果显示，在多个数据集上，该方法与明文版本的学习结果高度一致，因果结构质量相当。性能评估表明，即使在FHE保护下，完成因果结构学习也仅需数十分钟，具备实用性和高效性。本文为隐私保护的因果推断提供了新思路，适合对数据隐私、安全计算和机器学习交叉领域感兴趣的研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 因果结构学习在金融、医疗等敏感领域应用广泛，隐私泄露风险高。本文提出的FHE方案实现了加密状态下的因果学习，且效率可接受，为数据安全从业者提供了一种强隐私保护的技术路径。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可直接应用于分布式隐私保护的因果发现任务，如多方合作下的医疗数据分析、金融欺诈检测等场景；其电路优化和近似技术也可推广至其他FHE应用。

items.why_it_matters: 因果结构学习在金融、医疗等敏感领域应用广泛，隐私泄露风险高。本文提出的FHE方案实现了加密状态下的因果学习，且效率可接受，为数据安全从业者提供了一种强隐私保护的技术路径。

items.title: A-Live: Passive Liveness Detection via Neuromuscular Micro-Motion Signatures on Commodity Sensors
items.summary: Liveness detection has evolved from a safeguard against presentation and replay attacks in biometric authentication to a broader requirement for distinguishing human users from non-human agents in modern digital systems. The emergence of generative and agentic AI further amplifies this need, positioning liveness as a fundamental security primitive. Existing approaches face key limitations, including reliance on explicit user interaction, specialized hardware, vulnerability to increasingly realistic spoofing, and limited scalability in real-world deployments. We present A-Live, a passive liveness detection framework that operates solely on inertial measurement unit (IMU) signals available in commodity devices. A-Live is based on the observation that neuromuscular micro-motions inherent to human motor control produce subtle but measurable signatures in inertial data, which are often treated as noise in prior work. We design a lightweight feature extraction pipeline and a compact classifier suitable for real-time on-device deployment, and introduce a controllable physical micro-motion platform to evaluate robustness against engineered non-human motion. Extensive evaluation across Android and iOS devices, including both automated and real-user settings, shows that A-Live achieves over 99.5\% accuracy with low false acceptance and rejection rates. Our results demonstrate that neuromuscular micro-motion signatures provide a scalable and passive foundation for liveness detection under emerging AI-driven threat models.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为 A-Live 的被动活体检测框架，旨在解决当前生物认证系统和数字系统中区分人类用户与非人类代理（如生成式 AI 或智能体）的挑战。现有活体检测方法依赖用户主动交互（如眨眼、点头）、专用硬件（如红外摄像头）或易被复杂欺骗攻击绕过的特征，且难以大规模部署。A-Live 的核心创新在于利用商用设备（如智能手机、可穿戴设备）中普遍存在的惯性测量单元（IMU）传感器，通过分析人体运动控制中固有的神经肌肉微动作（neuromuscular micro-motions）在惯性数据中产生的微弱但可测量的信号特征，实现无源、非侵入式的活体检测。这些微动作信号在以往研究中常被视为噪声，而本文设计了一个轻量级的特征提取管道和紧凑型分类器，支持在设备端实时运行。为了评估系统对抗非人类运动的鲁棒性，作者还引入了一个可控的物理微动作平台，用于生成工程化的非人类运动数据。实验在 Android 和 iOS 设备上进行，包括自动化测试和真实用户场景，结果表明 A-Live 的准确率超过 99.5%，且误接受率和误拒绝率极低。该工作证明了神经肌肉微动作签名可作为在新型 AI 驱动威胁模型下可扩展且无源的活体检测基础。本文主要贡献包括：(1) 首次提出基于 IMU 的神经肌肉微动作活体检测方法；(2) 设计适合移动端部署的轻量级模型；(3) 构建物理微动作平台用于鲁棒性验证；(4) 在多个商用设备上验证了高精度与低延迟。适合安全研究人员、生物认证工程师及 AI 安全从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 当前生成式 AI 和智能体可模拟人类交互，传统活体检测面临挑战。A-Live 仅利用商用设备 IMU 信号即可被动、实时地识别真伪用户，为大规模部署提供低成本、高精度的安全解决方案。

items.title: Bernoulli CUSUM and Bayes-Optimal Detection Ceilings for Trust Fraud in Sparse Rating Networks
items.summary: Sequential trust detection in rating networks relies on continuous observation models that fail on real data. On Bitcoin-OTC, 56\% of ratings take a single value under standard mapping, breaking the distributional assumptions that parametric detectors require. This paper makes three contributions. It derives a Bayes-optimal F1 detection ceiling for per-node sequential detectors using empirically measured observation parameters. At Bitcoin-OTC's median in-degree of 2, this ceiling falls to 0.451 for strategic attacks, explaining why unsupervised methods cluster near $F1 \approx 0.4$. The analysis shows that detector-model matching, not information content, determines performance: binary models retain 86\% of mutual information while enabling exact parametric fit. A dual-regime architecture is presented where Bernoulli CUSUM detects behavioral shifts and triggers asymmetric scoring. Ablation reveals a co-design constraint: the modulation mechanism improves AUC by 0.030 on binary observations but degrades it by 0.094 on continuous observations. The combined system achieves AUC 0.749 on Bitcoin-OTC and 0.796 on Bitcoin-Alpha, beating GaaSTrust on all 8 attacks ($p < 0.003$), with founder-label AUC of 0.999.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对稀疏评分网络（如比特币交易网络 Bitcoin-OTC 和 Bitcoin-Alpha）中的信任欺诈序列检测问题展开研究。实际数据中，56%的评分在标准映射下呈现单一取值，破坏了连续观测模型的分布假设，导致传统参数检测器失效。论文提出三重贡献：首先，利用经验观测参数推导出每节点序列检测器的贝叶斯最优 F1 检测上限。在 Bitcoin-OTC 的中位数入度为 2 时，该上限在策略攻击下降至 0.451，解释了为何无监督方法的 F1 分数通常徘徊在 0.4 附近。其次，分析表明决定检测性能的关键是检测器与模型匹配度而非信息含量：二值模型保留了 86% 的互信息，同时允许精确参数拟合。最后，提出一个双机制架构，其中伯努利 CUSUM 检测行为偏移并触发不对称评分。消融实验揭示了协同设计约束：该调制机制在二值观测上将 AUC 提升 0.030，但在连续观测上却降低 0.094。综合系统在 Bitcoin-OTC 上达到 AUC 0.749，在 Bitcoin-Alpha 上达到 AUC 0.796，在全部 8 种攻击中均优于 GaaSTrust（p < 0.003），并实现了创始人标签 AUC 0.999。研究适合机器学习、网络安全及信任计算领域的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为稀疏评分网络中的欺诈检测提供了理论最优性能界，揭示了二值化模型在保持信息的同时提升检测效率的关键，对设计实际信任检测系统有重要指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至其他评分稀疏的在线信任系统（如电商评价、社交网络信誉），以及需要序列检测的异常行为场景。
detection_signals_zh: 伯努利 CUSUM 统计量超过阈值
评分序列中单值比例过高
节点入度较低时检测上限下降
defense_advice_zh: 采用二值化观测模型以匹配检测器假设
针对低入度节点降低检测阈值或结合图结构信息
避免在不匹配的连续观测模型上依赖参数检测器

items.title: Attention-Augmented LSTMs for Automatic Homophonic Ciphertext Decipherment
items.summary: Homophonic substitution ciphers replace each plaintext letter with one of several possible ciphertext codes, deliberately weakening letter-frequency patterns and making automated decipherment difficult. This paper evaluates whether an attention-augmented Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model can learn such mappings in a historically motivated shared-key setting: all ciphertexts draw from the same known homophonic code pool, while individual keys use different consistent subsets of that pool. Using synthetic ciphertexts generated with ChronoFidelius from historical English and Swedish texts dated 1500--1899, we test performance across ciphertext lengths, centuries, variable-length codes, and simulated transcription errors. Models are trained only on aligned ciphertext--plaintext pairs, without external language models, frequency statistics, or key-search heuristics. Results show near-perfect character-level decryption accuracy across both languages and all periods, including short and noisy ciphertexts. The model also fails predictably on ciphertexts outside the shared pool, indicating that it functions as a practical tool for decipherment and key-space verification when key reuse is suspected.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 同音替代密码通过将每个明文字母映射到多个可能的密文字符来削弱字母频率模式，使得自动解密变得困难。本文评估了一种注意力增强的长短期记忆网络（Attention-Augmented LSTM）在历史启发下的共享密钥设置中学习此类映射的能力：所有密文来自同一个已知的同音编码池，但每个个体密钥使用该池的不同一致子集。使用ChronoFidelius工具从1500–1899年的历史英语和瑞典语文本生成合成密文，测试了不同密文长度、世纪、变长码和模拟转录错误下的解密性能。模型仅基于对齐的密文-明文对进行训练，不依赖外部语言模型、频率统计或密钥搜索启发式。实验结果表明，该模型在两种语言和所有历史时期均实现了接近完美的字符级解密准确率，即使在短文本和含噪声的密文上也是如此。同时，模型在编码池之外的密文上可预测地失败，表明它可作为密钥重用怀疑时的实用解密和密钥空间验证工具。该研究为历史密码学分析提供了一种自动化方法，展示了深度学习在弱化频率分析的密码系统上的有效攻击能力。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究展示了深度学习在传统密码分析中的新应用，特别是针对同音替代密码这种弱化频率分析的密码系统。安全从业者可从中了解攻击者可能利用类似技术突破历史或低安全性密码，并警惕现代系统设计中的类似弱点。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 主要影响历史密码学领域，对现代高安全性加密（如AES）无直接威胁，但可迁移至其他基于替换的密码分析场景。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究展示了深度学习在传统密码分析中的新应用，特别是针对同音替代密码这种弱化频率分析的密码系统。安全从业者可从中了解攻击者可能利用类似技术突破历史或低安全性密码，并警惕现代系统设计中的类似弱点。

items.title: SharedRequest: Privacy-Preserving Model-Agnostic Inference for Large Language Models
items.summary: With the widespread deployment of public large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT, protecting user prompt privacy has become an increasingly critical issue. Existing privacy-preserving inference methods sacrifice either utility or efficiency, and often require model-specific modifications that limit their compatibility. In this paper, we propose SharedRequest, a model-agnostic framework for privacy-preserving LLM inference that reformulates privacy protection at the batch level rather than the individual-prompt level. The key idea is to obscure sensitive information by mixing original prompts with noisy variants, while grouping semantically equivalent instructions to amortize the inference cost over a large batch of queries with minimal impact on LLM response quality. This design is independent of the LLM architecture, requiring no access to model parameters or architectural modification. Empirical results demonstrate that SharedRequest achieves over $20\%$ higher utility compared to prior differential privacy baselines, and its shared-prompt mechanism reduces query cost by up to $5\times$ compared to non-batched inference.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 随着ChatGPT等大型语言模型（LLM）的广泛部署，用户提示的隐私保护成为一个关键问题。现有隐私保护推理方法要么牺牲效用，要么牺牲效率，且通常需要特定于模型的修改，限制了兼容性。本文提出SharedRequest，一个模型无关的隐私保护LLM推理框架，将隐私保护从单个提示级别重构为批处理级别。核心思想是通过将原始提示与噪声变体混合来混淆敏感信息，同时分组语义等价的指令，从而将推理成本分摊到大批量查询上，同时最小化对LLM响应质量的影响。该设计独立于LLM架构，无需访问模型参数或进行架构修改。实验结果表明，与先前的差分隐私基线相比，SharedRequest的效用提高了20%以上，其共享提示机制使查询成本比非批处理推理降低了5倍。该研究适用于所有需要保护用户查询隐私的LLM服务场景，尤其适合无法信任服务提供商的第三方应用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究解决了LLM推理中用户提示隐私保护的实用性问题，提出的模型无关框架无需修改模型即可实现高效隐私保护，对推动隐私保护LLM服务落地有重要意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于所有基于外部LLM API的应用场景，例如聊天机器人、文档摘要、代码生成等，可作为一种即插即用的隐私保护中间件。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究解决了LLM推理中用户提示隐私保护的实用性问题，提出的模型无关框架无需修改模型即可实现高效隐私保护，对推动隐私保护LLM服务落地有重要意义。

items.title: From Agent Traces to Trust: Evidence Tracing and Execution Provenance in LLM Agents
items.summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents increasingly solve complex tasks by interacting with external tools, retrieval systems, memory modules, environments, and other agents. These capabilities expand agent autonomy, but also make agent behavior harder to verify, debug, and audit. Final-answer accuracy alone cannot explain how an output was produced, which evidence supported each claim, whether tool calls were justified, how memory influenced later decisions, or where execution failures originated. Evidence tracing and execution provenance address this gap by modeling how retrieved evidence, tool outputs, memory items, environment observations, intermediate claims, actions, and final answers are connected throughout agent execution. This survey provides a systematic review and conceptual framework for evidence tracing and execution provenance in LLM agents. We organize related work around a unified provenance perspective that connects retrieval grounding, claim support, tool-use safety, memory lineage, observability, debugging, audit, and recovery. We introduce a taxonomy covering trace sources, evidence and execution units, provenance relations, tracing granularity and timing, representation forms, and trust functions. We review key methodological directions, including provenance representation, evidence attribution, tool-use provenance, runtime guardrails, provenance-bearing memory, trace-based observability, and failure diagnosis. We also map existing benchmarks, datasets, and evaluation metrics to provenance-related capabilities, and discuss how evaluation can move from final-answer correctness toward process-level accountability. Finally, we outline open challenges, including unified trace schemas, claim-level and semantic provenance, provenance-aware safety mechanisms, realistic execution-trace benchmarks, recovery-oriented evaluation, and privacy-aware audit infrastructure.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体通过与外部工具、检索系统、记忆模块、环境及其他智能体交互来解决复杂任务。这种能力扩展了智能体的自主性，但也使其行为更难以验证、调试和审计。仅依靠最终答案的准确性无法解释输出是如何生成的、每个主张由哪些证据支持、工具调用是否合理、记忆如何影响后续决策以及执行失败的根源。证据追踪与执行溯源通过建模检索证据、工具输出、记忆项、环境观察、中间主张、动作和最终答案在智能体执行过程中的关联方式，弥补了这一空白。本文作为一篇综述，系统性地回顾了LLM智能体中证据追踪与执行溯源的相关工作，并提出了一个统一的概念框架。我们围绕统一的溯源视角组织相关工作，涵盖检索基础、主张支持、工具使用安全、记忆谱系、可观测性、调试、审计和恢复。我们提出了一种分类法，涵盖追踪源、证据与执行单元、溯源关系、追踪粒度与时机、表示形式以及信任函数。我们回顾了关键方法论方向，包括溯源表示、证据归因、工具使用溯源、运行时护栏、带溯源的记忆、基于追踪的可观测性以及故障诊断。此外，我们映射了现有基准、数据集和评估指标到溯源相关能力，并讨论了评估如何从最终答案正确性转向过程级可问责性。最后，我们概述了开放挑战，包括统一追踪模式、主张级和语义溯源、溯源感知的安全机制、真实的执行追踪基准、面向恢复的评估以及隐私感知的审计基础设施。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文为安全工程师提供了系统性理解LLM智能体行为可验证性、可审计性问题的框架，有助于设计更可靠的智能体系统，预防和诊断因证据链断裂、工具误用等导致的安全事故。

items.why_it_matters: 本文为安全工程师提供了系统性理解LLM智能体行为可验证性、可审计性问题的框架，有助于设计更可靠的智能体系统，预防和诊断因证据链断裂、工具误用等导致的安全事故。

items.title: NLLog: Lightweight, Explainable SOC Anomaly Detection via Log-to-Language Rewriting
items.summary: System-generated logs underpin security monitoring, yet their rigid template-based format hinders both automated analysis and human comprehension. We present NLLog (Natural-Language Log), a lightweight pipeline that deterministically rewrites parsed templates into WHO-WHAT-SEVERITY sentences, pools them with term-frequency-inverse-document-frequency weighting, classifies sessions with tree ensembles, and back-projects evidence with TreeSHAP for analyst review. On Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) and Blue Gene/L (BGL) corpora, NLLog exceeds two reproduced matched-protocol baselines; across HDFS, BGL, and the AIT Alert Data Set, it sustains low false-positive rates with commodity-hardware latency suitable for security operations center triage. Coverage, sparse-versus-dense, faithfulness, and adversarial ablations show that fallback sufficiency is corpus-dependent, that an enrollment-time coverage check can surface refinement requirements before deployment, and that an auditable deterministic rewrite combined with lightweight dense encoding provides a measurable representation layer for log-anomaly detection and triage.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为NLLog（自然语言日志）的轻量级异常检测管道，旨在解决系统日志因模板化格式导致自动化分析和人工理解困难的问题。NLLog通过确定性规则将解析后的日志模板重写为“谁-做了什么-严重程度”形式的自然语言句子，然后使用TF-IDF加权池化，利用树集成（如随机森林）对会话进行分类，并通过TreeSHAP回溯证据以支持分析师审查。在HDFS和Blue Gene/L (BGL)数据集上，NLLog超过了两个复现的匹配协议基线；在HDFS、BGL和AIT警报数据集上，它保持了较低的误报率，且延迟适合安全运营中心（SOC）的初步筛选。消融实验（覆盖度、稀疏与密集、忠实性、对抗性）表明，回退充分性依赖于语料库，注册时的覆盖度检查可在部署前发现优化需求，且可审计的确定性重写结合轻量级密集编码为日志异常检测与分类提供了可衡量的表示层。该研究适用于安全分析师、SOC工程师以及对日志分析自动化感兴趣的研究人员。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为SOC提供一种轻量、可解释的日志异常检测方法，降低误报率并提升分析师效率。

items.why_it_matters: 为SOC提供一种轻量、可解释的日志异常检测方法，降低误报率并提升分析师效率。

items.title: From Attack Simulation to SIEM Rule: Deterministic Detection-as-Code Synthesis with Probe-Level Traceability
items.summary: Security teams routinely simulate attacks against their own systems to check whether their monitoring would catch a real intruder. These Breach-and-Attack-Simulation (BAS) tools surface findings, but the security information and event management (SIEM) systems that watch production need detection rules -- and today a human bridges that gap by hand, reading each finding and writing the corresponding Sigma rule (a vendor-neutral detection format). We show this translation can be partially automated when probes are drawn from a locked corpus, so each finding carries a stable identifier back to the originating probe. We describe a deterministic synthesis function that maps each finding to a starter Sigma rule through a small template library (N=23, indexed by categories from the OWASP LLM and Web Top 10), with a back-reference to the originating finding and its MITRE ATT&CK technique. On two locked corpora (17-probe LLM, 23-probe Web), every bypassed-probe finding yields a starter rule, and all 17/17 emitted rules parse and convert to Splunk and Elasticsearch backends. Replayed through a live OpenSearch SIEM, the LLM rules fire on 30% of a held-out AdvBench subset and 14% of HarmBench at 7.7% false positives on a benign baseline; the Web side is validated structurally, not against a held-out attack set. The contribution is a verifiable, byte-stable path from BAS finding to operator-deployable starter rule, re-derivable from the published corpus and template library alone -- trading the breadth of LLM-generative methods for exact reproducibility and a typed traceback from any fired alert to the originating probe.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种确定性的检测即代码合成方法，旨在将攻防模拟（Breach-and-Attack-Simulation, BAS）工具产生的发现结果自动转换为SIEM可用的检测规则。当前安全团队通常手动为每个发现编写Sigma规则（一种厂商中立的检测格式），流程耗时且易出错。作者利用锁定探测语料库（locked corpus）中每个探针携带的稳定标识符，实现从发现结果到Sigma规则的可复现映射。具体方法包括一个小型模板库（共23个模板，分别索引自OWASP LLM和Web Top 10分类），根据发现结果所属类别选择模板，并填充参数以生成起始规则。每条规则均包含指向原始发现和MITRE ATT&CK技术的后向引用。在两组锁定语料（17个LLM探针和23个Web探针）上测试，所有被绕过的探针发现均能生成起始规则，且生成的17条LLM规则和23条Web规则均能成功解析并转换为Splunk和Elasticsearch后端格式。进一步在实时OpenSearch SIEM上回放测试，LLM规则在AdvBench子集上触发率达30%，在HarmBench上为14%，同时在良性基线上的误报率为7.7%；Web规则仅进行了结构验证。主要贡献在于提供了一条可验证、字节稳定的从BAS发现到可部署起始规则的路径，且仅需发布语料库和模板库即可完全复现，相比于LLM生成方法牺牲了广度但获得了精确的可复现性和从任何报警到原始探针的类型化追溯。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 这项研究为安全运营团队提供了一种自动化、可复现的检测规则生成方法，减少人工编写Sigma规则的负担，并确保每条规则可追溯至原始探针，提升检测规则的透明度和可信度。

items.why_it_matters: 这项研究为安全运营团队提供了一种自动化、可复现的检测规则生成方法，减少人工编写Sigma规则的负担，并确保每条规则可追溯至原始探针，提升检测规则的透明度和可信度。

items.title: Sequential Data Poisoning in LLM Post-Training
items.summary: LLM post-training proceeds through multiple stages, e.g., supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) or direct preference optimization (DPO), where each stage draws data from different, potentially untrusted sources. Existing literature assumes data poisoning attacks may occur at each training stage, but neglects the possibility of multiple attackers. To study the trustworthiness of the entire post-training pipeline, we propose the threat model of sequential data poisoning, where multiple adversaries separately poison the SFT and preference datasets. Under this threat model, we identify the single-attacker illusion: each adversary, evaluated in isolation, appears to pose a negligible threat. Yet when adversaries collaborate across stages, the true vulnerability is revealed. In the SFT $\to$ DPO pipeline, their contributions are additive: splitting a fixed poison budget across stages outperforms concentrating it in either stage alone. In the SFT $\to$ PPO pipeline, their contributions are complementary: neither SFT nor reward model poisoning succeeds individually, yet their combination does. These findings show that security analyses of individual post-training stages systematically underestimate compound vulnerabilities that emerge only from their interaction. Code is available at https://github.com/jcksanderson/sequential-poisoning.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）后训练阶段中的顺序数据投毒威胁。LLM的后训练通常包括多个阶段，例如监督微调（SFT）和基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）或直接偏好优化（DPO）。现有文献通常假设每个训练阶段可能发生数据投毒攻击，但忽略了多个攻击者协同攻击的可能性。为此，作者提出了一种新的威胁模型——顺序数据投毒，其中多个对手分别污染SFT数据集和偏好数据集。在这种模型下，作者发现了“单攻击者幻觉”：单独评估每个攻击者时，其威胁似乎微不足道；但当攻击者在不同阶段协作时，真正的脆弱性便会暴露。具体地，在SFT→DPO流水线中，攻击者的贡献是加性的：将固定投毒预算分散到多个阶段的效果优于集中在单一阶段。在SFT→PPO流水线中，攻击者的贡献是互补的：单独污染SFT或奖励模型都失败，但二者结合却能成功。这些发现表明，对单个后训练阶段的安全分析会系统性地低估仅在交互中出现的复合漏洞。论文提供了开源代码以复现实验。该工作对LLM安全部署具有重要警示意义。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了LLM后训练流水线中跨阶段数据投毒的复合漏洞，打破了单一阶段安全分析的幻觉，对安全从业者设计防御策略具有指导作用。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响任何采用多阶段后训练流程的LLM安全评估，可迁移至SFT、RLHF、DPO等场景。

items.why_it_matters: 揭示了LLM后训练流水线中跨阶段数据投毒的复合漏洞，打破了单一阶段安全分析的幻觉，对安全从业者设计防御策略具有指导作用。

items.title: TeeDAO: A Decentralized Autonomous Organization for Heterogeneous TEEs
items.summary: Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) have emerged as a critical technology for safeguarding sensitive data and ensuring code integrity in modern computing systems. However, relying on a single TEE implementation makes systems vulnerable to a central point of attack. Building distributed-trust systems leveraging heterogeneous TEEs helps disperse trust but still faces threats from centralized management and adaptive mobile adversaries. To address these challenges, this paper introduces TeeDAO, a novel three-layer framework that automatically organizes multiple heterogeneous TEE instances and provides unified interfaces to support diverse applications, while ensuring long-term guarantees of availability, integrity, and confidentiality. TeeDAO couples BFT-ordered governance with heterogeneity-aware Distributed Proactive Secret Sharing (DPSS) and Secure Multi-Party Computation (MPC) so that attestation-driven committee changes are consistently reflected in secret recovery, resharing, and computation across a dynamic committee of heterogeneous TEEs. We implement a prototype of TeeDAO, integrating COBRA's DPSS scheme with the HotStuff BFT consensus protocol, and adapt it for Intel SGX, TDX, and Hygon CSV. Evaluations demonstrate that TeeDAO achieves up to 1.8x higher key-value store throughput in a large cluster with 61 nodes compared to state-of-the-art systems, efficient autonomous management, and minimal computation overhead (<18%) for multi-party computation tasks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文提出TeeDAO，一个面向异构可信执行环境（TEE）的去中心化自治组织框架。当前依赖单一TEE实现（如Intel SGX）的系统存在单点攻击风险，而利用异构TEE构建分布式信任系统虽可分散信任，但仍面临集中式管理和自适应移动对手（如攻击者逐步攻破多个TEE节点）的威胁。TeeDAO通过三层架构解决这些问题：第一层为BFT排序治理层，基于HotStuff共识协议确保委员会变更的有序性；第二层为异构感知的分布式主动秘密共享（DPSS）层，结合COBRA方案实现秘密的动态恢复与重共享；第三层为安全多方计算（MPC）层，支持在动态委员会上执行隐私计算。各层通过远程认证驱动协同工作，使委员会变更一致地反映在秘密恢复和计算中。原型实现适配了Intel SGX、TDX和Hygon CSV三种TEE硬件，实验表明在61节点集群中，键值存储吞吐量较现有系统提升最多1.8倍，自治管理开销极低，MPC附加计算开销低于18%。该工作为构建抗单点故障的分布式可信计算奠定了基础。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: TeeDAO为异构TEE环境提供了首个自动去中心化管理框架，解决了集中式管理带来的单点故障和自适应对手问题，对云原生安全、机密计算和联邦学习等场景具有重要参考价值。

items.title: CLIF: Cross-layer LEO-ISL Fingerprinting for Physical and Network Attack Detection in Dense LEO Constellations
items.summary: Low-Earth Orbit (LEO) mega-constellations such as Starlink by SpaceX and Kuiper by Amazon rely on optical Inter-Satellite Links (ISLs) for autonomous mesh routing to provide low-latency telecommunication, Internet of Things (IoT), and security services globally. As commercial operators and governments deploy increasingly dense constellations and form multi-operator peering coalitions, ISL integrity becomes critical to both commercial availability and national security. However, there is a lack of real-world data for LEO constellations and existing real-time security approaches focus strictly on physical layer security, leaving blind spots in the coverage of network-layer and composite attacks. In this paper, we present a cross-layer, lightweight behavioral fingerprinting framework that fuses onboard physical-layer measurements with network-layer data to detect anomalies at low computational overhead. We construct an orbital simulation covering the first shells of Starlink (1,584 satellites), Kuiper (1,156 satellites), and a joint multi-operator peering scenario (2,740 satellites), injecting ten attack types that span spoofing, traffic manipulation, and routing subversion at varying severity. We evaluate three unsupervised, per-satellite detectors among which our Mahalanobis-distance-based detector achieves 99.5% recall on Starlink, 99.4% on Kuiper, and 94.8\% on the multi-operator constellation, while maintaining False Positive Rates (FPR) below 0.7%. Our results demonstrate that cross-layer feature fusion is not only necessary for comprehensive security of LEO constellations but highly cost-effective for large-scale networks while fitting into the strict onboard energy budgets of resource-constrained satellites.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文提出了一种面向低地球轨道（LEO）巨型星座（如 SpaceX 的 Starlink 和 Amazon 的 Kuiper）的跨层轻量级指纹识别框架 CLIF，用于检测物理层和网络层的攻击。LEO 星座依赖光学星间链路（ISL）进行自组织网状路由，为全球提供低延迟通信、物联网和安全服务。随着星座密度增加和多运营商对等互联联盟的形成，ISL 的完整性对商业可用性和国家安全都至关重要。然而，现有实时安全方法专注于物理层安全，忽略了网络层和复合攻击的盲点。作者构建了涵盖 Starlink（1,584 颗卫星）、Kuiper（1,156 颗卫星）以及多运营商对等互联场景（2,740 颗卫星）的轨道仿真，注入了十种攻击类型，包括欺骗、流量操纵和路由颠覆，每种攻击分为不同严重等级。他们评估了三种基于单星的无监督检测器，其中基于马氏距离的检测器在 Starlink 上达到 99.5% 的召回率，Kuiper 上 99.4%，多运营商星座上 94.8%，同时误报率（FPR）低于 0.7%。结果表明，跨层特征融合对于 LEO 星座的全面安全不仅是必要的，而且对于大规模网络具有高成本效益，同时适合资源受限卫星的严格星上能量预算。本文的主要贡献在于：1）首次提出结合物理层和网络层特征的轻量级指纹识别框架；2）在真实规模的多运营商星座仿真中验证了有效性；3）为 LEO 星座安全提供了可部署的解决方案，适合安全研究员、卫星通信工程师和星座运营商阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LEO星座是未来通信和国家安全的关键基础设施，但现有安全方法存在网络层盲点。本文提出的跨层轻量级指纹识别框架能高效检测多种攻击，对保障星座安全运营具有重要实践意义。

items.title: DIST-FL: Enhancing Security for TEE-based Aggregation in Federated Learning
items.summary: Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs)-aided federated learning protocols emerge as promising solutions to counter server-side adversaries and ensure the trustworthiness of the server. In this paper, we dissect existing protocols and demonstrate that server-side adversaries can still manipulate client selection and replay aggregation to compromise system robustness and privacy, by exploiting TEE limitations, i.e., state rollback and I/O manipulation. To this end, we present DIST-FL, a distributed system of servers guarded by multiple TEEs forming an append-only ledger for privacy-preserved, robust FL aggregation. Specifically, DIST-FL ensures operation linearizability to thwart state rollback attacks and incorporates inputs from reliable servers to mitigate I/O manipulation threats. We implement DIST-FL and conduct evaluations in WAN settings. Experimental results demonstrate that DIST-FL can effectively counter the proposed attacks and match the single-TEE's performance while offering a 6x throughput boost over its counterparts, leveraging TEE's computational advantages.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本研究聚焦于可信执行环境（TEE）辅助的联邦学习协议中的安全问题。现有协议依赖单一TEE来保护聚合过程，但作者发现服务器端攻击者可以操纵客户端选择和重放聚合，从而破坏系统鲁棒性和隐私。这些问题源于TEE的局限性，即状态回滚和I/O操纵攻击。为此，作者提出DIST-FL，一个由多个TEE保护的分布式服务器系统，通过形成仅追加账本（append-only ledger）来实现隐私保护且鲁棒的联邦学习聚合。DIST-FL的核心设计是确保操作线性化（linearizability），从而阻止状态回滚攻击；同时，它结合来自可靠服务器的输入来缓解I/O操纵威胁。作者在广域网（WAN）设置下实现了DIST-FL并进行了评估。实验结果表明，DIST-FL能够有效防御所提出的攻击，并且性能与单TEE方案相当，同时利用TEE的计算优势，其吞吐量相比同类方案提升了6倍。该工作为联邦学习中的安全聚合提供了新的分布式架构思路，适合对联邦学习安全、TEE应用以及分布式系统安全感兴趣的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 针对TEE辅助联邦学习中的服务器端攻击提出了一种分布式防御架构，展示了如何利用多个TEE和仅追加账本解决状态回滚和I/O操纵问题，对实际部署具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至其他依赖TEE的分布式计算场景，如隐私保护的机器学习训练、安全多方计算等。

items.title: ODYSSEY: Reestablishing Confidentiality in Confidential Blockchain via Delegated Execution
items.summary: Confidential blockchains leveraging Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) have garnered extensive attention for transaction confidentiality. In this paper, we first taxonomize two classes of attacks against confidential blockchains, i.e., execution-inference and execution-replay attacks, which exploit TEEs' long-lasting side-channel and state-continuity issues to compromise the confidentiality of existing consortium blockchains. Then, we present ODYSSEY, a confidential blockchain that efficiently mitigates these attacks. The core innovations of ODYSSEY are the following: (1) Its delegation model: clients delegate transaction execution to their designated trustees, while other participants synchronize only the execution results, which significantly reduces the attack surface while preserving confidentiality and system performance. (2) Two novel techniques to improve ODYSSEY's efficiency and security: location-aware concurrent execution and delegation failure handler. Finally, we develop a prototype of ODYSSEY on FISCO BCOS, an enterprise-grade consortium blockchain platform. We have conducted various experiments, and our evaluation results show that in a WAN environment with 3 nodes, ODYSSEY can achieve about 4k throughput while keeping latency as low as 0.4-0.5s.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对利用可信执行环境（TEE）的联盟链面临的机密性威胁进行了系统研究。作者首先将针对机密区块链的攻击分为两类：执行-推理攻击（通过长时间侧信道推断交易内容）和执行-重放攻击（利用TEE状态持续性漏洞重放交易以窃取信息）。为缓解这些攻击，提出ODYSSEY系统，其核心创新包括：（1）委托执行模型：客户端将交易执行委托给指定的受托者，其他节点仅同步执行结果，大幅减少攻击面同时保持机密性和系统性能；（2）两种优化技术：位置感知并发执行和委托失败处理机制。基于FISCO BCOS企业级联盟链平台实现了原型系统，在3节点的广域网环境中，吞吐量达到约4000 TPS，延迟低至0.4-0.5秒。该研究为机密区块链安全提供了新思路，适合区块链安全研究员和TEE应用开发者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次系统分类并针对性防御TEE在区块链场景下的两大机密性攻击，委托执行模型可有效缩小攻击面，对联盟链实际部署有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至其他基于TEE的分布式系统机密性保护场景，如隐私计算、联邦学习等。

items.title: The Usefulness Gap in Proof-of-Useful-Work: An Empirical Study of Pearl's cuPOW Protocol
items.summary: Pearl, a Layer-1 blockchain with high-profile AI industry endorsements, markets its Proof-of-Useful-Work (PoUW) protocol as simultaneously securing the network and performing AI inference. We present the first systematic empirical measurement of a deployed PoUW system, finding that Pearl's 24 EH/s network -- representing approximately 320,000 GPU-equivalents consuming an estimated 112 MW -- produces zero useful AI computation. Budget GPU rental prices rose 38% and utilization surged from 57% to 94% following the mining software's public release, displacing legitimate research workloads. Our measurements span five dimensions: (1) network composition analysis of 8,012 workers shows all have inference-capable hardware, yet the dominant mining software contains no inference code; (2) the verification protocol accepts random matrices by design, confirmed by 44 pool-accepted shares from our open-source miner across NVIDIA, AMD, CPU, and Apple Silicon hardware; (3) statistical distribution checks are trivially defeated by adversarial Gaussian sampling; (4) mining is unprofitable at current PRL prices ($0.21) across all GPU tiers (-54% to -72% ROI); and (5) the mining computation is commodity integer arithmetic portable to any hardware platform, offering no vendor lock-in. These findings quantify the verifiability-usefulness tension identified theoretically by Leinweber et al., providing concrete measurements of its magnitude and economic consequences in a deployed system.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本研究针对Pearl区块链的Proof-of-Useful-Work（PoUW）协议进行了首次系统性实证测量。PoUW声称在保障网络安全的同时执行AI推理计算，但作者通过五个维度的测量发现该协议存在严重的有用性差距。测量包括：1）对8012个矿工的网络组成分析显示所有硬件均具备推理能力，但主流挖矿软件不含任何推理代码；2）验证协议设计上接受随机矩阵，作者通过开源挖矿软件在NVIDIA、AMD、CPU和Apple Silicon硬件上提交的44个矿池接受的份额证实了这一点；3）统计分布检查极易被对抗性高斯采样绕过；4）在当前PRL价格（0.21美元）下，所有GPU级别的挖矿均不盈利（ROI范围-54%到-72%）；5）挖矿计算是通用的整数运算，可移植到任何硬件平台，不提供供应商锁定。研究量化了理论上的可验证性-有用性矛盾，展示了部署系统中该矛盾的实际规模和经济后果。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了区块链PoUW协议在实际部署中完全无法实现承诺的AI计算，导致大量算力浪费（约112MW电力）并挤占合法科研计算资源，对区块链安全可信度构成根本性质疑。

items.title: Description-Code Inconsistency in Real-world MCP Servers: Measurement, Detection, and Security Implications
items.summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has emerged as a critical standard empowering Large Language Models (LLMs) to utilize external tools. In this ecosystem, LLMs rely on natural language descriptions provided by MCP servers to select and execute functions. This interaction implicitly assumes that tool descriptions faithfully reflect their underlying implementations, while this assumption is not mandatorily verified in practice. As a result, MCP deployments may suffer from a problem named Description-Code Inconsistency (DCI), where a tool's description of its capabilities and security boundaries is not consistent with what the code actually does. In this paper, we present a comprehensive study of DCI in real-world MCP servers. We formally define the problem and propose a comprehensive taxonomy spanning functionality inconsistencies and undeclared side effects. Guided by this taxonomy, we develop DCIChecker, an automated framework that combines structure-aware static analysis with the Direct-Reverse-Arbitration prompting method to cross-validate tool descriptions against actual code implementations. We apply this framework to a large-scale dataset comprising 19,200 description-code pairs extracted from 2,214 real-world MCP servers. Our measurement reveals that DCI is widespread, with 9.93% of these pairs exhibiting inconsistencies. We further demonstrate that DCI creates a critical defense blind spot, facilitating varied risks from operational failures to stealthy malicious behaviors. Finally, we propose mitigation strategies to enforce semantic consistency and enhance the reliability of the emerging agentic ecosystem.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）与外部工具交互的关键协议——模型上下文协议（MCP）中的描述-代码不一致（DCI）问题进行了系统性研究。在MCP生态中，LLM依赖工具的自然语言描述来选择和执行函数，但该描述与底层代码实现之间的一致性并未得到强制验证，从而产生安全盲区。作者首先正式定义了DCI问题，并提出了包含功能不一致和未声明副作用两类的全面分类法。基于此分类，他们开发了DCIChecker自动化框架，该框架结合了结构感知静态分析和直接-反向-仲裁（Direct-Reverse-Arbitration）提示方法，交叉验证工具描述与实际代码实现。研究团队将该框架应用于大规模数据集，从2,214个真实MCP服务器中提取了19,200个描述-代码对。测量结果显示DCI普遍存在，9.93%的对存在不一致。进一步实验表明，DCI可导致从操作故障到隐蔽恶意行为等多种风险。最后，作者提出了强制语义一致性、增强新兴代理系统可靠性的缓解策略。本文适合AI安全、LLM应用安全及协议设计领域的研究者与工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次对MCP协议中描述与代码不一致问题进行大规模测量，揭示了LLM工具调用机制中的重要安全盲区，直接关系到AI代理的安全性与可靠性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有基于MCP的LLM应用，包括工具选择错误、权限绕过、数据泄露等；风险可迁移至任何依赖自然语言接口的代理系统。
detection_signals_zh: 工具描述与实际代码逻辑存在差异（如参数范围、副作用、权限声明）
静态分析发现代码中存在描述未声明的文件操作、网络请求或系统调用
使用DCIChecker框架进行交叉验证可检测不一致
defense_advice_zh: 强制要求MCP服务器提供描述与代码的一致性验证
部署自动化工具（如DCIChecker）定期审计描述-代码对
建立描述与代码的自动同步机制，减少人工编写偏差
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：将DCIChecker方法纳入内部安全评估流程，并关注后续缓解方案
